about: Configured act fields (2026-10-19): the RAP „Vizualizare act” (rap-03q, ozone act) vs the EVO Cabinet act window (pp-01x, depot act) — the same GEAPActView renderer must look the same on both pages. Different data → sizes / positions that depend on content are ignored. Run: node --experimental-websocket --no-warnings tools/ui-qa/compare-styles.mjs --a rap-03q --b pp-01x --spec tools/ui-qa/specs/act-fields-rap-vs-cabinet.json Cell / toggle right edges depend on the data (column contents, „Arată toate (12)” vs „(7)”).
